AuditRecord.description: The record of one change of the PublicationState of an Evaluation: which Evaluation, the state it entered, who caused it and when. It carries identifiers only, never the text of an Utterance, a rationale or a score.

actor.description: Who caused a change of PublicationState: the identifier of a reviewer, or the name of the system when no person was involved.

publication_state.description: Where an Evaluation stands on its way to the Representative.

AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

Call.description: One recorded conversation between a customer and a Representative, held as its Utterances in the order they were spoken.

call_id.description: The unique identifier of a Call.

representative.description: The Representative who handled a Call.

utterances.description: The Utterances of a Call, in the order they were spoken.

Call.title: Call

Criterion.description: One thing a Representative is expected to do on a Call, worded so that a Call either meets it or does not.

critical.description: Whether failing this Criterion fails the whole Evaluation, whatever the score. Absent means false.

weight.description: How much a Criterion counts towards the score, relative to the other Criteria of its Scorecard.

Criterion.title: Criterion

Disposition.description: What happens to an Evaluation once it is complete.
Disposition.title: Disposition

Evaluation.description: The assessment of one Call against one Scorecard: exactly one Finding per Criterion, and the score, outcome and disposition that follow from them.

disposition.description: Whether an Evaluation stands as it is or must be reviewed by a person first.

findings.description: The Findings of an Evaluation, one per Criterion of its Scorecard.

score.description: The weight of the Criteria a Call met, as a whole-number percentage of the weight of the Criteria that applied to it.

Evaluation.title: Evaluation

EvaluationOutcome.description: The possible outcomes of an Evaluation.
EvaluationOutcome.title: EvaluationOutcome

Finding.description: The judgement of one Criterion for one Call: whether the Call met it, the Utterances cited in support and a short rationale.

cited_utterances.description: The sequence numbers of the Utterances a Finding relies on. In this context "evidence" is not used for them: in the workflow ontology Evidence means the result of a test run.

criterion.description: The Criterion a Finding judges or a Rejection is about.

finding_outcome.description: Whether the Call met the Criterion.

rationale.description: One or two sentences on why a Finding has its outcome.

Finding.title: Finding

FindingOutcome.description: The possible outcomes of a Finding.
FindingOutcome.title: FindingOutcome

PublicationState.description: Where an Evaluation can stand on its way to the Representative.
PublicationState.title: PublicationState

Rejection.description: The refusal to record a proposed Finding, to complete an Evaluation or to publish one, because it breaks a rule. It names the rule and says what would have been accepted, so that the proposer can correct itself.

allowed_values.description: The values that would have been accepted, where they form a closed set.

criterion.description: The Criterion a Finding judges or a Rejection is about.

detail.description: What was wrong, in words the proposer can act on.

rejection_rule.description: The rule a Rejection reports as broken.

Rejection.title: Rejection

RejectionRule.description: The rules a proposed Finding, an Evaluation or the publication of an Evaluation can break.
RejectionRule.title: RejectionRule

Representative.description: The bank employee who handles a Call.

representative_id.description: The bank's identifier for a Representative.

Representative.title: Representative

Review.description: A person's decision on an Evaluation whose disposition is NEEDS_REVIEW: whether the Evaluation stands. A Review is not a second Evaluation and it does not change the Findings or the score.

reviewer.description: The bank's identifier for the person who made a Review.

Review.title: Review

Scorecard.description: The list of Criteria that Calls of one kind are evaluated against, together with the pass mark an Evaluation has to reach.

pass_mark.description: The lowest score at which an Evaluation passes.

scorecard_id.description: The unique identifier of a Scorecard, including its version.

Scorecard.title: Scorecard

Utterance.description: One uninterrupted stretch of speech by one Speaker in a Call. Utterances are numbered from 1 in the order they were spoken.

sequence.description: The position of an Utterance in its Call, counted from 1.

text.description: The words of an Utterance, as transcribed.

Utterance.title: Utterance
